name: vitals
description: A compact stats dock that adapts to its size and highlights problems at a glance.
long_description: Vitals replaces the built-in Stats dock with a compact, theme-aware dock. It changes layout to fit the space you give it, stays neutral while everything is fine, and turns amber or red when a metric crosses a threshold. It also shows GPU usage, session time and every active output, including multistream targets.
